headlines.title: 공휴일에도 24시간 가동한 외환시장
headlines.summary: 환율 1480원대 소폭 상승 변동성은 크지 않아 외환시장이 24시간 체제로 전환된 뒤 첫 공휴일인 17일 서울 을지로 하나은행 딜링룸에 원·달러 환율이 표시돼 있다.   /뉴스1 24시간 거래 체제로 전환된 이후 첫 공휴일(제헌절)인 17일 서울외환시장에서 원·달러 환율이 1480원대에서 소폭 상승했다.

headlines.title: [단독] 韓美거래소 8월 MOU …" 24시간 거래체계 협력 "
headlines.summary: 22년 만에 협약 틀 개편 추진 한국거래소가 미국 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)와 24시간 거래체계 협력 등을 담은 업무협약(MOU) 체결에 나선다. 2004년 양측이 포괄적 업무협약을 맺은 지 22년 만에 협력 틀을 전면적으로 개편하고 범위를 확대한다는 점에서 의미가 있다.

headlines.title: 상반기 서울 아파트값, 18년만에 가장 많이 올라
headlines.summary: 주담대 한도 규제에도 5.07% 상승 공급 부족에 실수요자 매수 전환 15억이하 밀집지 상승 두드러져 사진은 14일 서울 송파구 롯데월드타워 서울스카이에서 바라본 강남 3구 아파트 모습. 2026.06.14 뉴시스 올해 상반기(1∼6월) 서울 아파트값 누적 상승률이 2008년 이후 가장 높은 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 수도권 전세거래 급감 여파 … 주택금융보증 7년만에 최저
headlines.summary: 주금공, 올해 32만건에 그쳐 토허제에 전세매물 실종되고 총량관리로 대출 줄어든 영향 한국주택금융공사(HF)가 공급하는 전세보증 등 주택금융보증이 부동산 규제에 따른 전세 매물 실종과 당국의 가계대출 강화 기조 여파 등으로 7년 만에 최저 수준으로 줄어들었다.

headlines.title: 금리인상 후폭풍 … 고령층부터 타격
headlines.summary: 취약차주 5명중 1명 60대 이상 대출 연체율도 4년새 2배로 고령 자영업자 평균 빚 3.9억 한국은행이 기준금리를 2.75%로 인상하며 긴축 통화정책으로 선회한 가운데 향후 시장금리가 따라 오를 때 고령층에 먼저 충격이 가해질 수 있다는 전망이 제기된다.

headlines.title: 60대이상 취약차주 빚 평균 1억원 … 30대보다 2배 많아
headlines.summary: 금리인상 직격탄 … 고령층 취약차주 비상 고령 자영업자 금융빚 405조 비은행 대출 10년새 7배 급증 매출 둔화·이자부담 이중고 신현송 "채무조정 등 필요" 챗GPT "취약차주 문제는 항상 염두에 두고 있다. 이 부분이야말로 정부와 금융당국의 조화로운 정책이 중요하다.

headlines.title: 中企 연체율 , 대기업 의 4배 … 금리인상 기조에 '좌불안석'
headlines.summary: 중기 57%, 돈벌어 이자도 못내 변동금리 대출 많아 부담 가중 본격적인 기준금리 인상 사이클이 시작되면서 경기 침체와 소비 부진 등으로 어려움을 겪고 있는 중소기업과 자영업자들의 재정 부담이 더 커질 것으로 보인다. 가뜩이나 연체율이 치솟는 상황에서 감당해야 할 이자가 불어나기 때문이다. 17일 금융감독원에 따르면 올해 4월 중소기업 연체율은 0.

headlines.title: 빗나간 예측에 남아도는 일자리 추경
headlines.summary: 예산정책처 2025년 결산 분석 본예산도 못쓴 사업에 증액 소부장 예산도 집행률 30%대 친환경차 전환, 15%사용 그쳐 "목적성·신속성 원칙 살려야" 정부는 고용 악화와 민생경제 위기에 대응하기 위해 지난해 두 차례 추가경정예산(추경)을 편성했다.

headlines.title: 최저임금 제도개선 착수 … 대상확대·임금차등 논의
headlines.summary: 내년도 최저임금이 시간당 1만700원으로 결정된 가운데 고용노동부가 되풀이되는 소모적 갈등을 끊어내기 위해 제도 개선에 본격 착수했다. 17일 관계부처에 따르면 고용노동부는 최근 '최저임금 결정 기준 합리화 및 운영 방식 개선에 관한 연구' 용역을 발주했다. 가장 큰 쟁점은 적용 대상이다.

headlines.title: 보호무역에 대응 … 韓, 중견국 협의체 'FIT-P' 가입
headlines.summary: 스위스·싱가포르 등 19개 회원국 WTO 이후 세계 통상규칙 모색 한국이 세계무역기구(WTO) 체제 이후의 새로운 통상 규칙을 모색하는 중견국 협의체인 ‘미래투자교역파트너십(FIT-P)’에 가입했다.

headlines.title: 일본의 AI 독립 선언 "제조업 특화 AI 육성"

key_headlines.title: Housing Finance Guarantees Hit 7-Year Low Amid Jeonse Market Collapse
key_headlines.summary: Korea Housing Finance Corporation's housing finance guarantees fell to 320,000 cases this year, the lowest in 7 years, due to vanishing jeonse listings from housing regulations and stricter loan management policies.

key_headlines.title: Elderly and Low-Income Borrowers Face Sharp Rate Hike Impact
key_headlines.summary: Following the Bank of Korea's base rate increase to 2.75%, vulnerable borrowers aged 60 and above are experiencing severe financial strain, with loan delinquency rates among elderly self-employed business owners doubling over four years to an average debt of 390 million won.

key_headlines.title: Japan Launches Sovereign AI Project with 44 Companies
key_headlines.summary: Japan launched a national 'Sovereign AI' project led by SoftBank with 44 participating companies and up to 1 trillion yen in government investment to develop AI specialized in manufacturing.

key_headlines.title: SME Delinquency Rate Four Times Higher Than Large Corporations
key_headlines.summary: Small and medium enterprises face delinquency rates four times higher than large corporations amid rising interest rates, with 57% holding variable-rate loans that burden their finances further.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Prices Rise Most in 18 Years Despite Mortgage Regulations
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment prices surged 5.07% in the first half of 2026, the highest increase since 2008, as supply shortages drove real purchasers back to the market with particularly strong gains in properties under 1.5 billion won.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's housing finance sector faces significant headwinds as jeonse transaction volumes collapse, driving housing finance guarantees to their lowest level in seven years at 320,000 cases. The broader economy grapples with rising interest rates and their cascading effects on vulnerable populations, particularly elderly borrowers and small business owners whose debt burdens have intensified. Meanwhile, Seoul's real estate market demonstrates surprising resilience with apartment prices reaching 18-year highs despite mortgage restrictions, indicating a bifurcated market where supply constraints continue to drive prices upward. The government and financial authorities are implementing various stabilization measures, including adjustments to leverage ETF deposit requirements and rate hike policies.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea raised its base rate by 25 basis points to 2.75% on July 16, marking the first increase in 42 months and signaling a shift toward monetary tightening. This decision followed strong economic data across all GDP components, with the central bank signaling potential additional rate hikes pending second quarter GDP figures due July 23. The rate increase has triggered concerns about rising household debt and financial strain on vulnerable borrowers, particularly elderly self-employed individuals and small businesses with variable-rate loans. Economic growth projections are under review with the central bank suggesting upward adjustments to the 2.6% growth forecast based on robust investment, consumption, and export performance.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI index experienced significant volatility, plummeting over 6% to fall below the 7,000-point level amid semiconductor concerns and the base rate hike, creating a volatile 'roller coaster' trading environment. Authorities announced complementary measures including increased deposit requirements for single-stock leverage ETFs for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to mitigate excessive leverage risks and market instability. Foreign investors and institutions increased selling pressure following the rate hike announcement, while the won-dollar exchange rate declined slightly to the 1,480 level. Market sentiment remains cautious as investors await earnings reports from major tech companies, particularly semiconductor firms, to gauge whether the sector can rebound from pessimistic outlook.
sections.Industry & Technology: Hyundai Motor and Kia surpassed Tesla in electric vehicle battery health retention after two years of use, marking a significant achievement in battery performance and residual value concerns. LG Energy Solution is transitioning from battery cell manufacturing to become an energy platform company, integrating battery and software solutions for comprehensive ESS (Energy Storage Systems) offerings. South Korea is accelerating development of 'water batteries' using pumped-storage hydroelectricity to address power grid saturation from rapid solar installation growth and reduce ESS fire risks. However, all-solid-state battery commercialization targets originally set for 2025-2026 have been largely postponed or remain in pilot production stages, delaying near-term revenue expectations.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market exhibits triple strength with sales prices, jeonse, and monthly rental prices all rising simultaneously for 27 consecutive months, reaching 18-year highs in the first half of 2026. Jeonse prices surged 4.99% and monthly rents increased 4.55% in the first half, the largest increases since 2015 statistics began, driving mid-to-low-end apartments and outer Seoul areas to post new highs. Non-apartment housing starts declined 5.5% year-over-year to 12,358 units in January-May 2026, with May alone dropping 15.4% month-over-month, while jeonse and monthly rental prices for villas simultaneously increased as supply constraints persist. Rising housing costs are pushing younger generations toward home purchases as rental expenses become prohibitive, though debates continue over whether weekly apartment price statistics published by Korea Real Estate Board should be discontinued.
sections.International Economy: President Trump escalated trade tensions by demanding Canada pay additional tariffs related to wildfire smoke entering U.S. eastern regions, exemplifying increasingly unconventional diplomatic approaches. The International Monetary Fund projects China's government debt-to-GDP ratio will rise from 99.2% to 120.3% by 2029, approximately double the U.S. debt increase rate, raising concerns about China's fiscal sustainability. Trump administration concerns over moral hazard have intensified as the president appears to profit from policy announcements affecting stocks he owns, creating potential conflicts of interest. U.S. import prices unexpectedly rebounded in June despite energy price declines, indicating inflation pressures are spreading across other product categories beyond energy sectors.
sections.AI & Economy: South Korea's technology leaders argue that Korean AI companies must focus on exporting 'intelligence' rather than products to break through global competition, emphasizing the need for strategic differentiation in the AI arms race. SK Group Chairman Choi Tai-won stated plans to create 10 AI agent clones to assist with decision-making while expressing confidence in continued memory chip demand growth as AI systems require larger storage capacity for development. Business leaders emphasize the importance of identifying tasks only humans can perform while integrating AI capabilities, using examples like John Deere's success in autonomous farming equipment despite traditional manufacturing origins. Ryuten Technologies CEO Park Min-jun warns that AI will replace leadership tasks within one year, urging companies to prioritize AI transformation in revenue-generating and cost-cutting operations rather than merely automating repetitive tasks.
sections.Others: Government economic stimulus packages in 2025 proved ineffective due to inaccurate employment forecasting, leaving billions of won in budgeted items unutilized despite expectations of labor market deterioration and consumer economic crisis. The government tripled deposit requirements for single-stock leverage ETFs to 30 million won to curb excessive speculation and market volatility in concentrated semiconductor holdings. Moral hazard concerns regarding the Trump administration intensified as prediction markets showed remarkable accuracy predicting policy outcomes that correlate with the president's personal financial interests. Korean students pursuing advanced degrees in the United States face visa extension uncertainties under the Trump administration, creating financial risks and potential deportation concerns that may deter future international education.
